prerequisites: A competence in English corresponding at least to B1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL).

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding globally and selectively both oral and written texts on topics belonging to the personal and social sphere and to English for IT Engineering.

Taking part in conversations and interact in discussions in a way appropriate to the context in different social and professional communicative situations; being able to write simple texts of personal and professional content.

Producing linear and cohesive oral and written texts to refer facts and describe situations connected to personal experiences and to the specialised field of IT Engineering; analysing, rephrasing and summarising simple texts on professional topics.

Ability to select, analyze, apply critically one’s own judgment to the materials, the situations and the areas of study and work; reflecting on the linguistic system (phonology, morphology, syntax, lexicon) and on language uses (functions, variety of registers and texts, etc.), also in a comparative perspective, in order to identify analogies and differences with the Italian language.

Acquiring skills and competences useful to obtain success in the world of work and in society (life skills e soft skills); reinforcing foreign language learning strategies in order to develop study autonomy; enhancing professional lexis and topics in the English language, by using texts and materials drawn from various sources.

assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a written test and an oral interview, each making up 50% of the final mark. To pass the written test, a mark of at least 18/30 is required. Passing the written test is a precondition to access the oral test.
